# spl404-forge

> See what is really inside a Solana transaction, then inscribe your own files on-chain with your wallet. Transaction v1 ready.

spl404-forge is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/spl404-forge/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference

- [Quick start](https://github.com/nirholas/spl404-forge/blob/HEAD/README.md#quick-start)

- [How it is put together](https://github.com/nirholas/spl404-forge/blob/HEAD/README.md#how-it-is-put-together)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/spl404-forge/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
